macro.text: Oil fell over $1 on easing geopolitical fears and oversupply worries
Dollar hit a 19-month high against Asia FX as yen approached 160
Japan PPI inflation surged past expectations in October
Gold clung below $4,000 even as inflation fears fuel bigger Fed-move bets
Treasury yields held up despite falling oil, breaking their usual tight link
Russia and Ukraine agreed a prisoner swap but US says trust still lacking in talks

corporate.note: CoreWeave jumped 24% on a strong Q3 report, sparking a broad AI chip-stock rally
Stock sank 8% after-hours on reports board may oust CEO Huang over a personal scandal
Alphabet's debut Hong Kong and Singapore bond sale drew about $5 billion in early orders
Head of infrastructure Santosh Janardhan to exit in 2027, succeeded by ex-AWS executive
American Airlines reinstated fresh food in NY-Chicago first class for first time since 2019
JetBlue unveiled new first-class seats as part of a push to restore profitability
Rep. David Kustoff disclosed a sale of Warner Bros. Discovery shares

frontPage.watch: Watch for Nvidia board news on Huang's fate and whether elevated yields keep pressuring the AI-trade rally.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3737 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.840 + 0.971×ln(VIX) + 0.314×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
